name: adena
description: Use the Adena wallet from your agent: connect, create scoped session accounts, and send or sign gno.land transactions as the user.

interface.shortDescription: Act on gno.land as the Adena user through approved session accounts
interface.longDescription: Connects your agent to the Adena browser wallet. The user approves a scoped session account once in Adena; the agent then sends or signs gno.land transactions with it. Transactions can also be sent to Adena for the user to approve one by one.
defaultPrompt: Check whether my Adena wallet is connected.
Create a one-hour session that can call gno.land/r/demo/counter.
Send 1 GNOT to g1... from my Adena wallet.
